label: Geysers at golden hour
title: Geysers at golden hour
description: Steam and mineral textures build toward eruptions in golden light and a pink evening sky. Original narration explains their unpredictability; keep the changing light as the sequence’s payoff.
full_description: 蒸汽先在开阔地热盆地中升起，镜头靠近岩石中的泉口，随后交替展示强烈喷发的水柱、被蒸汽遮掩的岩石锥体和蓝天下的喷泉全景。光线转暖后，金色逆光照亮喷出的水与雾，最后以紫红晚霞中的喷发收尾。原声讲解强调间歇泉变化的不可预测性，画面从结构细节走向自然力量与光线的高潮。金色喷泉和晚霞最值得保留，可缩短相似日景，不把不同时间与机位表述成同一场喷发。
context: Continuous excerpt from Yellowstone In Depth: Geysers, NPS / Steven M. Bumgardner. Different eruptions and lighting conditions; not one continuous event. No NPS endorsement.

highlight.reason: Backlight turns the water and steam gold while a dark treeline gives the eruption a clear silhouette.

analysisModel: Qwen3-VL visual draft + editorial shot review · Whisper + source-caption correction

transcript.text: Geysers are what we call mathematically chaotic systems.
Slight variations in the amount of cold water coming in,
the amount of heat coming up,
a change in the plumbing system can give you dramatically different results,
and what I enjoy seeing is not the reproducibility of geysers,
We're lucky we can predict the 5 or 6 that we can, and that can vary from year to year, whether or not we can predict maybe how big a window around them.
I think it teaches us to respect natural systems that don't operate on our time frame.

label: Wild Alaska
title: Wild Alaska
description: A feeding brown bear gives way to winding rivers, blue lakes and snow-covered peaks. Original narration connects wildlife with the landscape; the bright mountain reveal is the visual payoff.
full_description: 棕熊在浅水中进食，海鸟在旁走动；镜头随后升到森林上方，沿弯曲河道展示林地与苔原，再转向云雾中的陡峭雪山、蓝色湖湾和覆雪火山。旁白将动物获取食物与阿拉斯加的地貌连接起来，叙事由生命细节扩展到广阔环境。棕熊进食和明亮雪峰最有保留价值，航拍适合建立空间或作为章节高潮；可压缩相似山景的停留，不应把不同机位误写为同一次连续飞行。
context: Continuous excerpt from the NPS Lake Clark film (2018). Original narration preserved; no added graphics. Not unedited camera footage. No NPS endorsement.

highlight.reason: Bright snow, a clearly defined summit and blue sky create the strongest landscape reveal, without titles or graphics.

transcript.text: Their bodies feed ocean-derived nutrients to wildlife, humans, and the land.
Here, rolling tundra and boreal forest are intersected by the Chigmit and Neacola Mountains.
The Neacolas stand among snowy giants, a part of the mighty Alaska Range which reaches north to the highest peaks on the continent.
The Chigmits rise at the head of the Aleutian Range, a complex of glacier-topped mountains that stretch south and west to the far reaches of the state.
Two active volcanoes, Iliamna and Redoubt, tower above the Chigmit mountains.
